segments.ja401:1.1: Paṇṇakaṃ [dasaṇṇakaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] tikhiṇadhāraṃ, asiṃ sampannapāyinaṃ;
segments.ja401:1.3: Parisāyaṃ puriso gilati, kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:1.5: Yadaññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja401:2.3: Yo ca vajjā dadāmīti, taṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:2.5: Sabbaññaṃ sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi maddava [māgadha (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja401:3.1: Byākāsi āyuro pañhaṃ, atthaṃ [attha (pī. sī. niyya)] dhammassa kovido;
segments.ja401:3.3: Pukkusaṃ dāni pucchāmi, kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:3.5: Yadaññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja401:4.3: Yo ca datvā avākayirā, taṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:4.5: Sabbaññaṃ sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi maddava.
segments.ja401:5.1: Byākāsi pukkuso pañhaṃ, atthaṃ dhammassa kovido;
segments.ja401:5.3: Senakaṃ dāni pucchāmi, kiṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:5.5: Yadaññaṃ dukkaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja401:6.1: Dadeyya puriso dānaṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ;
segments.ja401:6.3: Yo ca datvā nānutappe [tape (sī. pī.)], taṃ dukkarataraṃ tato;
segments.ja401:6.5: Sabbaññaṃ sukaraṃ ṭhānaṃ, evaṃ jānāhi maddava.
segments.ja401:7.3: Sabbe pañhe atibhoti, yathā bhāsati senakoti.
